# mockfs

Generated mock implementations of all `ihfs` FS and File interfaces.

## Generation

Mocks are generated by `mockfs/generate.sh` using `mockgen`. Run via:

```bash
make generate
```

**Do not edit generated files by hand.** If a mock is wrong, fix `generate.sh` or the source interface and re-run `make generate`.

## Adding a New Interface

1. Add the interface name to the appropriate array in `generate.sh`
2. Run `make generate`
3. The new mock will appear in `mockfs/dist/`

## Coverage

Coverage not required — this is generated code.
